text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Migraine with aura. The combination of bilateral throbbing pain worsening in the morning, alongside intermittent flashing lights (scintillating scotoma) and blurriness, is highly characteristic of migraine with aura. While the pain is often unilateral, it can be bilateral, especially in chronic cases or during the aura phase.
